Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers with 9 neighbors (2 As, 6 Co, 1 P), Co centers with 15 neighbors (4 As, 4 Co, 7 P), and P centers with 11 neighbors (6 As, 2 Co, 3 P). The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Co and P polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between As and Co polyhedra.
